analysis.summary: Sonam Limited reported its financial performance for the first half of FY27, highlighting significant growth in revenue, operating profit, and net profit compared to the previous year. Management noted that the revenue expansion was driven largely by increased domestic activities, trading volumes, and strategic raw material sourcing, despite headwinds from higher export freight costs. The company outlined long-term financial targets and ongoing efforts to introduce premium models and expand OEM relationships with brands like Titan and Amazon. Sonam Limited reported its financial performance for the first half of FY 2026-27, highlighting substantial growth in revenue, EBITDA, and profit after tax. Revenue from operations reached ₹19,596.41 lakhs, up 183.10% year-on-year, while EBITDA grew by 121.31% to ₹1,194.68 lakhs.

guidance.claim: Management expects turnover for the financial year to be around Rs. 300 crore to Rs. 350 crore.
guidance.quote: According to us revenue is around Rs. 300 crore to Rs. 350 crore. We hope it should be that.

guidance.claim: Management projects reaching a PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore and an EPS of Rs. 5 to Rs. 6 by 2028-2029.
guidance.quote: Our plan is to provide maximum benefit to shareholders till 2028, 2029 and do PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore. And our EPS becomes Rs. 5 to Rs. 6.

guidance.claim: Management states profit will grow by 40% to 50% in any way.
guidance.quote: But our profit will grow by 40%, 50% in any way.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the full-year revenue growth guidance is 25% to 30%.
guidance.quote: you have given the guidance that full-year guidance will be 25% to 30% growth.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates revenue for the next quarter to be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.
guidance.quote: For the next quarter we hope that revenue will be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth is coming more from domestic markets and improvements in the clock movements business.
demand_outlook.quote: Actually, our growth is coming more from domestic. Secondly, there is an improvement in our clock movements business.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand increased due to expanded distribution channels and the development of new models.
demand_outlook.quote: It is because of that. And the second thing is that according to domestic, we have developed a lot of models. So according to that, we have got a good response.

demand_outlook.claim: Purchase power in tier-2 and tier-3 cities has increased, prompting a focus on premium customers.
demand_outlook.quote: So our focus now is that even in the tier two, tier three-city, very good clocks are sold. And the purchase power of those people is also increased. So our focus is now more on premium customers.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the first quarter reflected strong operational performance and steady demand across the product portfolio.
demand_outlook.quote: The 1st Quarter of FY’27 has been an increasing start to the financial year, reflecting strong operational performance, deadly demand across our product portfolio and our continuing commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction.

margins_costs.claim: Half-year FY27 revenue from operations reached Rs. 195 crores, EBITDA reached Rs. 11.94 crores, and PAT reached Rs. 6.75 crores.
margins_costs.quote: During the half-year FY’27, our revenue from operations increased by 183%, reaching Rs. 195 crores compared with Rs. 69 crores in the corresponding period of the previous financial year. This remarkable increase in operations represents a significant step forward for our company and sets a strong benchmark. For our future aspirations, our EBITDA increased by 121%, reaching Rs. 11.94 crores compared with Rs. 5.39 crores in half-year FY’26. Our EBITDA margin stood at 6.7% compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year. More importantly, our profit after tax witnessed expansional growth of 213%, reaching Rs. 6.75 crores compared with Rs. 2.22 crores in FY’26 half-year.

margins_costs.claim: Imported goods carry an average operating margin of 3% to 4%, while trading and manufacturing activities yield a 21% gross profit.
margins_costs.quote: Actually, in imported goods, we have an average margin of 3% to 4% and the average margin in trading activity and in manufacturing activity, there is 21% gross profit.

margins_costs.claim: Freight cost accounts for 30% to 40% of other expenses due to significant increases in export freight.
Raw material prices increased in the market, leading management to focus on business growth through special schemes and discounts.
margins_costs.quote: Actually, the raw material prices got increased in the market but we focused more on the business and by giving special schemes and special discount we grew the business.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin stood at 6.07% compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period of the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA margin stood at 6.07%, compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49% for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49%, reflecting our continued focus on operation efficiency, disciplined cost management and sustainable profitability.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that margin side is fluctuating because daily raw material prices are increasing and decreasing.
margins_costs.quote: Margin side is fluctuating because daily raw material price is increasing and decreasing. So, the margin is fluctuating a bit.

orders_capacity.quote: The capacity utilization for now is 52%.

orders_capacity.claim: Current manufacturing capacity utilization level is stated to be 60% to 70% on a quarter-to-quarter basis.

capital_allocation.claim: Dividend paid including corporate dividend tax was 120.10 lakhs for the period ending 30-09-2026.
Management confirmed there are no requirements for additional borrowing to fund future growth.

risks_headwinds.claim: Export volumes were impacted due to increases in export freight costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Actually this year freight cost has increased in export. So, according to that export is a little less. There is an effect on export.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that geopolitical situations do not have a major impact on operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: No, there is not that much impact.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to launch eight to ten new models in the coming two to three months.
management_commitments.quote: And we have launched a lot of new models in these two months. And in the coming two, three months we will launch eight to ten new models.

management_commitments.claim: Management's plan is to provide maximum benefit to shareholders and achieve a PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore and an EPS of Rs. 5 to Rs. 6 by 2028-2029.
management_commitments.quote: Our plan is to provide maximum benefit to shareholders till 2028, 2029 and do PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore. And our EPS becomes Rs. 5 to Rs. 6.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated its plan to develop and sell clocks in the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 during the year 2027-28.
management_commitments.quote: So, our segment, our market planning is we will sell clock in the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 and develop such items in this year, 2027-28.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
